programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programs.title: Lord Of The Flies
programs.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programs.title: Locke
programs.desc: Ivan Locke (Tom Hardy) is one of the best civil engineers in England.He has just finished working on a construction site in Birmingham and is driving to London, where he lives.Tomorrow is the most important day of his career so far, and it is related to the project of a gigantic apartment building.While traveling home, Ivan receives one phone call that completely changes his life... Tom Hardy and Steven Knight had already met during the production of the second season of the series about English gangs of the 1920s, entitled"Peaky Blinders".Hardy played the boss of a Jewish gang, Alfie Salomons, and Knight co-wrote the script.

programs.title: On Swift Horses
programs.desc: 1950s. Newlyweds Muriel (Daisy Edgar-Jones) and Lee (Will Poulter) move from Kansas to San Diego, where a new home and job awaits them.At this time, the man's brother, Julius (Jacob Elordi), who has just returned from the Korean War, reappears in their lives.The former veteran is an accomplished poker player.So he goes to Las Vegas, where he supervises a casino and becomes friends with another gaming enthusiast, Henry (Diego Calva).All this time, she corresponds by letter with her sister-in-law.The woman, bored with her everyday life, is fascinated by the world of gambling in which her brother-in-law operates.Under his influence, he secretly begins betting on horse races.She soon leaves her husband and sets off on an exciting journey together with his brother.
